name: FormDesign
title: page layout and publishing for the web and the desktop
summary: A page-layout application for magazines, books, reports, print and websites, with its own Rust layout engine, 71 templates and an MCP server for agents.
lede: FormDesign is the form family's page-layout application for magazines, newsletters, books, reports, print pieces, ads, websites and blogs. It is made for people and their agents. Drop content on the Make panel, write a brief, pick a template and press Make layout, then refine the result in a full editor.
checks: Turns Markdown, Word, RTF, text, HTML, CSV, spreadsheets, PDFs, images and a plain-words brief into one content pack.
Ranks and fills 71 templates, threads articles through continuation pages and matches images to frames.
Composes text with a Knuth-Plass paragraph composer, styles, tables, footnotes and vector drawing.
Exports layouts as responsive multi-page websites and publishes a link served from this computer.

facts.dd: FormDesign's own Rust engine: 394 commands and 41 tools, in a JSON-lines sidecar
Vanilla TypeScript and Vite, Python and FastAPI, Rust and Tauri 2
Frontend on http://localhost:5196, engine on http://127.0.0.1:8196

chapters.title: From a brief to a layout
chapters.text: Intake reads your files and brief for kind, size, page count, tone, colours and brand. The Make pass ranks templates, fills them, threads the article through continuation pages, matches images to frames, fits copy and reports what is still sample text.

chapters.title: A full layout editor
chapters.text: Tiled rendering with overlays, 41 tools, and menus built from the core's 394 commands, with a dialog for every command that takes options. Edit > Search finds every command, panel and tool.

chapters.title: Print, PDF and the web
chapters.text: Any layout can become a responsive multi-page site with a sitemap and feed, and File > Publish Online gives a link served from this computer. Print production has separations preview, soft proofing through ICC profiles and an Ink Manager.

features.title: Intake
features.text: Many inputs become one compact content pack.
bullets: Markdown, Word, RTF, text, HTML, CSV and spreadsheets
PDFs with structure-aware extraction, images and GIFs
A brief in plain words, read for kind, size, page count, tone, colours, brand, event name and date
Key: value lines become fields

features.title: Templates
features.text: 71 templates across magazine, newsletter, book, report, print, stationery, ad, web and presentation.
bullets: Slotted for automatic filling
Re-skinned by a brand kit
docs/TEMPLATES.md is the format, so you can add your own

features.title: The Make pass
features.text: Ranks templates for your content and fills them.
bullets: Titles, decks, bylines, stats, features, captions and contact fields
Threads the article through continuation pages
Matches images to frames and fits copy
Reports what is still sample text

features.title: Websites
features.text: Any layout as a responsive multi-page site in its own type and colours.
bullets: An article per page with a home page of cards
A web template's rows and columns stack on a phone
Sitemap and feed via File > Export > Website
File > Publish Online for a link served from this computer

features.title: Agents
features.text: An MCP server with 38 tools and five task prompts.
bullets: outline, inspect, look and use_tool let an agent read, measure, see and draw cheaply
Window > Agent Connect shows each connected agent
Allow, ask or deny per agent and approve risky steps such as publishing

features.title: The editor
features.text: A tiled renderer with overlays and 41 tools.
bullets: Menus built from 394 commands, with a dialog for every command that takes options
Row editors for styles, tabs, rules and gradient stops, never JSON
Edit > Search over every command, panel and tool

features.title: Workspace pieces
features.text: Panels for long and careful work.
bullets: Rulers with drag-out guides (Ctrl+R), the Glyphs panel and the Tabs ruler
One Styles tab for paragraph, character and object styles
Books via File > Book with chapters, numbering and one PDF
The Story Editor (Ctrl+Y)
Seven built-in workspaces and your own

features.title: Review and output
bullets: Track Changes, Notes and Conditional Text panels
Separations Preview with ink limit (Shift+F6) and Overprint Preview
Soft proofing through ICC profiles, with paper simulation and colour-blindness views
The Ink Manager

features.title: Long documents
bullets: Footnotes, a table of contents, an index and cross-references that update
Hyperlinks, PDF bookmarks and text variables
Data merge, QR codes and anchored objects
Copy and paste across documents, Step and Repeat, Pathfinder

features.title: Editing text at scale
features.text: Search and proofing across a document.
bullets: Find/Change (Ctrl+F) with Text, GREP, Glyph and Object tabs and saved queries, also the find_change MCP tool
Check Spelling (Ctrl+I) and Dynamic Spelling in the text's own language
US English built in and twenty more dictionaries

features.title: Interactive and structure
bullets: Object States, Buttons and Forms and Page Transitions panels
XML Tags and Structure panels (Alt+Ctrl+1) with style mapping and DTD validation
Libraries of saved pieces, also as the library MCP tool

features.title: Drawing
bullets: All ten Pathfinder operations, offset path, outline stroke, simplify
The Curvature, Knife, Shape Builder and Width tools
Live effects and thirteen warps with several fills and strokes per object

features.title: Footnotes and tables
bullets: Footnotes spanning columns, restarting per page or section or numbered across stories
Table rows that split across frames under repeated headers
Slanted and dimensioned cell styles and rounded table corners

parity.summary: Of the 133 capabilities the references document, FormDesign is full on 127, partial on 5 and has nothing for 1, re-graded in code at 0.84.5 against InDesign (2026 release) and Affinity by Canva. DesignCraft, the closest open rival, scores 74 percent to FormDesign's 97 on the 133 scored rows.

requirements: Rust stable for the layout core
docs.install:
git clone https://github.com/nodemode-dev/formdesign.git
cd formdesign
./formdesign install
(Windows: formdesign.bat install)
docs.agents: An MCP server with 38 tools and five task prompts, with the skills formdesign-harness, formdesign-template-creator and formdesign-skillset in .claude/skills/.

topics.title: Templates
topics.text: docs/TEMPLATES.md describes the template format, and ./formdesign templates lists the 71 templates.

topics.title: Command line
topics.text: ./formdesign cmd runs any engine command, ./formdesign tool runs any MCP tool and ./formdesign make builds a layout from files and a brief.

topics.title: Wiki and branching
topics.text: .docs/wiki is the developer wiki and .docs/BRANCHING.md is the branch and release model.

topics.title: Changelog
topics.text: CHANGELOG.md lists every release, newest first.

items: The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window on PCs where the .js file type is set to text/plain
The Windows layout core includes the Visual C++ runtime, so it starts without the Redistributable
The Windows desktop build stops with an error when the bundle step fails
Line endings are fixed for Windows checkouts
The desktop splash no longer shifts its logo when the rest of the card arrives
A smoke test of the built window runs in CI
